name: Investment Fund Class Processing Characteristics
definition: Processing characteristics linked to the instrument, ie, not to  the market.

ReinvestmentFrequency.name: Reinvestment Frequency
ReinvestmentFrequency.definition: Frequency with which the reinvestment takes place,  This is the same or less than the dividend frequency,

FrontEndLoadIndicator.name: Front End Load Indicator
FrontEndLoadIndicator.definition: Front end charge on subscription orders for this class can be applied.

BackEndLoadIndicator.name: Back End Load Indicator
BackEndLoadIndicator.definition: Exit charge (eg. CDSC) on redemption orders for this class can be applied.

SwitchingFeeIndicator.name: Switching Fee Indicator
SwitchingFeeIndicator.definition: If a separate fee for switching between sub-funds of the same umbrella can be applied.

LimitedSubscriptionPeriod.name: Limited Subscription Period
LimitedSubscriptionPeriod.definition: Specific period, eg, for some guaranteed funds, during which the units/shares may be subscribed to.

LimitedRedemptionPeriod.name: Limited Redemption Period
LimitedRedemptionPeriod.definition: Specific period, eg, for some guaranteed funds, during which the units/shares may be redeemed.

Decimalisation.name: Decimalisation
Decimalisation.definition: Number of decimal places to which quantities of units/shares are rounded.

HoldingTransferableIndicator.name: Holding Transferable Indicator
HoldingTransferableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether registered investors are able to transfer some or all of their holdings to third parties.

SignatureRequired.name: Signature Required
SignatureRequired.definition: Specifies which type of signature is required when completing an initial subscription, when completing a subsequent subscription, and when completing redemption.

AmountIndicator.name: Amount Indicator
AmountIndicator.definition: Indicates whether subscriptions/redemption in amount are allowed.

UnitsIndicator.name: Units Indicator
UnitsIndicator.definition: Indicates whether subsciptions/redemption may be placed as a number of units.

OrderCutOffDateTime.name: Order Cut Off Date Time
OrderCutOffDateTime.definition: Last date/time at which an order to subscribe or an order to redeem can be given.

HoldingTransferable.name: Holding Transferable
HoldingTransferable.definition: Indicates whether registered investors are able to transfer some or all of their holdings to third parties.

DealingFrequency.name: Dealing Frequency
DealingFrequency.definition: Frequency at which the subscriptions and redemptions are done.

LimitedPeriod.name: Limited Period
LimitedPeriod.definition: Specific period, eg, for some guaranteed funds, during which the units/shares may be redeemed.

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Date/time as from which the processing characteristics are valid.

SubsequentSubscriptionApplicationForm.name: Subsequent Subscription Application Form
SubsequentSubscriptionApplicationForm.definition: Physical application form for subsequent investments by the same investor.

RedemptionForm.name: Redemption Form
RedemptionForm.definition: Physical written instruction/renunciation form for redemption of units/shares by the investor.

DealingCurrency.name: Dealing Currency
DealingCurrency.definition: Currency in which a subscription or redemption is accepted.

MinimumHoldingAmount.name: Minimum Holding Amount
MinimumHoldingAmount.definition: Minimum value of units that must be maintained to avoid automatic redemption.

MaximumRedemptionUnits.name: Maximum Redemption Units
MaximumRedemptionUnits.definition: Maximum number of shares/units that may be redeemed on a single dealing day.

MinimumHoldingUnits.name: Minimum Holding Units
MinimumHoldingUnits.definition: Minimum number of units that must be maintained to avoid automatic redemption.

MinimumRemainingHoldingAmount.name: Minimum Remaining Holding Amount
MinimumRemainingHoldingAmount.definition: Minimum value of units/shares that must be retained to avoid automatic redemption.

MaximumRedemptionPercentage.name: Maximum Redemption Percentage
MaximumRedemptionPercentage.definition: Maximum quantity of securities, expressed as a percentage that can be sold.

MaximumRedemptionAmount.name: Maximum Redemption Amount
MaximumRedemptionAmount.definition: Maximum quantity of securities, expressed as an amount that can be sold.

MinimumInitialSubscriptionUnits.name: Minimum Initial Subscription Units
MinimumInitialSubscriptionUnits.definition: Minimum initial number of units/shares that must be purchased.

MinimumSubscriptionAmount.name: Minimum Subscription Amount
MinimumSubscriptionAmount.definition: Minimum quantity of securities, expressed as an amount that must be purchased.

MinimumInitialSubscriptionAmount.name: Minimum Initial Subscription Amount
MinimumInitialSubscriptionAmount.definition: Minimum initial quantity of securities, expressed as an amount that must be purchased at subscription.

MinimumSubscriptionUnits.name: Minimum Subscription Units
MinimumSubscriptionUnits.definition: Minimum number of units/shares that must be purchase by existing investors.

MinimumHoldingPeriod.name: Minimum Holding Period
MinimumHoldingPeriod.definition: Description of a period, that may be a number of days, weeks or descriptive period during which the units/shares must be held following their issue before redemption will be permitted.

MinimumRedemptionPercentage.name: Minimum Redemption Percentage
MinimumRedemptionPercentage.definition: Minimum percentage of holding that may be redeemed.

SettlementCycle.name: Settlement Cycle
SettlementCycle.definition: An agreed number of days after the Trade date (T) used to define standard timeframes e.g T+3 settlement period |Where T = the date the price is applied to a transaction.

FundClass.name: Fund Class
FundClass.definition: Investment fund class for which processing characteristics are specified.

SettlementAccount.name: Settlement Account
SettlementAccount.definition: Account used for settlement of fund transactions.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Country in which the processing characteristic applies.

LocalMarketAnnex.name: Local Market Annex
LocalMarketAnnex.definition: Context, or geographic environment, in which trading parties may meet in order to negotiate and execute trades among themselves.

DealingCutOffTimeFrame.name: Dealing Cut Off Time Frame
DealingCutOffTimeFrame.definition: Specifies the number of days for cut off before or after an activity.
